content.text: Now I'll create a standardized version of this TSV file. I'll clean it up with consistent formatting:

input.command:
cd /mnt/user-data/uploads && python3 << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd

# Read the TSV file
df = pd.read_csv('met_inventory.tsv', sep='\t', dtype=str)

# Standardize column names to lowercase and remove extra spaces
df.columns = [col.strip().lower().replace(' ', '_') for col in df.columns]

# Fill empty cells with proper empty string representation
df = df.fillna('')

# Remove leading/trailing whitespace from all cells
for col in df.columns:
    df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()

# Replace empty strings back after stripping
df = df.replace('nan', '')

# Print info about the data
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Columns: {list(df.columns)}")
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())
print("\nData types:")
print(df.dtypes)

# Save the standardized version
output_path = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/met_inventory_standardized.tsv'
df.to_csv(output_path, sep='\t', index=False, quoting=1)  # quoting=1 is QUOTE_ALL
print(f"\nFile saved to: {output_path}")

EOF
